mapper.select: SELECT f.figure_id, f.status, f.payment_type, f.name, f.delivery_month, f.reservation_deadline, f.price, f.quantity, f.deposit_amount, f.balance_due_date, f.deposit_paid_at, f.paid_at, f.delivered_at, f.purchase_link, CONCAT('/uploads/', ti.file_path) AS thumbnail_url, ft.figure_type_id, ft.name AS figure_type_name, ftg.figure_type_group_id, ftg.name AS figure_type_group_name, sh.shop_id, sh.name AS shop_name, sg.shop_group_id, sg.name AS shop_group_name, m.maker_id, m.name AS maker_name FROM figure f JOIN figure_type ft ON ft.user_id = f.user_id AND ft.figure_type_id = f.figure_type_id JOIN figure_type_group ftg ON ftg.user_id = ft.user_id AND ftg.figure_type_group_id = ft.figure_type_group_id JOIN shop sh ON sh.user_id = f.user_id AND sh.shop_id = f.shop_id JOIN shop_group sg ON sg.user_id = sh.user_id AND sg.shop_group_id = sh.shop_group_id JOIN maker m ON m.user_id = f.user_id AND m.maker_id = f.maker_id LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image ti ON ti.user_id = f.user_id AND ti.target_type = 'FIGURE' AND ti.target_id = f.figure_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.figure_id DESC

SELECT f.figure_id, f.status, f.payment_type, f.name, f.delivery_month, f.reservation_deadline, f.price, f.quantity, f.deposit_amount, f.balance_due_date, f.deposit_paid_at, f.paid_at, f.delivered_at, f.purchase_link, CONCAT('/uploads/', ti.file_path) AS thumbnail_url, f.description, f.created_at, f.updated_at, ft.figure_type_id, ft.name AS figure_type_name, ftg.figure_type_group_id, ftg.name AS figure_type_group_name, sh.shop_id, sh.name AS shop_name, sg.shop_group_id, sg.name AS shop_group_name, m.maker_id, m.name AS maker_name FROM figure f JOIN figure_type ft ON ft.user_id = f.user_id AND ft.figure_type_id = f.figure_type_id JOIN figure_type_group ftg ON ftg.user_id = ft.user_id AND ftg.figure_type_group_id = ft.figure_type_group_id JOIN shop sh ON sh.user_id = f.user_id AND sh.shop_id = f.shop_id JOIN shop_group sg ON sg.user_id = sh.user_id AND sg.shop_group_id = sh.shop_group_id JOIN maker m ON m.user_id = f.user_id AND m.maker_id = f.maker_id LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image ti ON ti.user_id = f.user_id AND ti.target_type = 'FIGURE' AND ti.target_id = f.figure_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.figure_id = #{figureId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO figure (user_id, status, name, delivery_month, reservation_deadline, price, quantity, figure_type_id, shop_id, maker_id, purchase_link, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{request.name}, #{request.deliveryMonth,jdbcType=DATE}, #{request.reservationDeadline,jdbcType=DATE}, #{request.price}, #{request.quantity}, #{request.figureTypeId}, #{request.shopId}, #{request.makerId}, #{request.purchaseLink,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{request.description,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE figure SET name = #{request.name}, delivery_month = #{request.deliveryMonth,jdbcType=DATE}, reservation_deadline = #{request.reservationDeadline,jdbcType=DATE}, price = #{request.price}, quantity = #{request.quantity}, figure_type_id = #{request.figureTypeId}, shop_id = #{request.shopId}, maker_id = #{request.makerId}, purchase_link = #{request.purchaseLink,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, description = #{request.description,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_id = #{figureId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM figure WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_id = #{figureId}
mapper.update: UPDATE figure SET status = #{status}, payment_type = COALESCE(#{paymentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, payment_type), deposit_amount = COALESCE(#{depositAmount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, deposit_amount), deposit_paid_at = COALESCE(#{depositPaidAt,jdbcType=DATE}, deposit_paid_at), balance_due_date = COALESCE(#{balanceDueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, balance_due_date), paid_at = COALESCE(#{paidAt,jdbcType=DATE}, paid_at), delivered_at = COALESCE(#{deliveredAt,jdbcType=DATE}, delivered_at) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_id = #{figureId}
